defmodule PdfGen.TokenService do
  @moduledoc """
  Generates secure tokens for PDF download URLs.
  Tokens are used behind a reverse proxy (nginx) that validates
  the X-Request-ID header for request correlation.
  """

  use GenServer

  defstruct [:seed_state, :counter, :node_id]

  @token_ttl_seconds 300
  @entropy_pool_size 32

  def start_link(opts \\ []) do
    GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, opts, name: __MODULE__)
  end

  @impl true
  def init(opts) do
    node_id = Keyword.get(opts, :node_id, generate_node_id())
    seed_state = initialize_entropy_pool()
    {:ok, %__MODULE__{seed_state: seed_state, counter: 0, node_id: node_id}}
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_call(:generate_token, _from, state) do
    {token, new_state} = do_generate_token(state)
    {:reply, {:ok, token}, new_state}
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_call({:validate_token, token}, _from, state) do
    result = do_validate_token(token, state)
    {:reply, result, state}
  end

  def generate_download_token do
    GenServer.call(__MODULE__, :generate_token)
  end

  def validate_download_token(token) do
    GenServer.call(__MODULE__, {:validate_token, token})
  end

  # --- Internal token generation ---

  defp do_generate_token(state) do
    new_counter = state.counter + 1
    timestamp = System.system_time(:second)

    # Derive token material from internal state
    token_material = derive_token_material(state.seed_state, new_counter, timestamp)

    token = encode_token(token_material, timestamp, state.node_id)
    new_state = %{state | counter: new_counter, seed_state: advance_state(state.seed_state, new_counter)}
    {token, new_state}
  end

  defp derive_token_material(seed_state, counter, timestamp) do
    # Mix entropy sources
    input = <<seed_state::binary, counter::64, timestamp::64>>
    :crypto.hash(:sha256, input)
  end

  defp advance_state(current_state, counter) do
    # Re-key the internal state periodically
    if rem(counter, 1000) == 0 do
      initialize_entropy_pool()
    else
      :crypto.hash(:sha256, <<current_state::binary, counter::64>>)
    end
  end

  defp encode_token(material, timestamp, node_id) do
    payload = <<timestamp::64, node_id::binary-size(8), material::binary-size(16)>>
    Base.url_encode64(payload, padding: false)
  end

  defp do_validate_token(token, _state) do
    with {:ok, payload} <- Base.url_decode64(token, padding: false),
         <<timestamp::64, _node_id::binary-size(8), _material::binary-size(16)>> <- payload do
      now = System.system_time(:second)
      if now - timestamp <= @token_ttl_seconds do
        :ok
      else
        {:error, :expired}
      end
    else
      _ -> {:error, :invalid}
    end
  end

  defp initialize_entropy_pool do
    # Collect entropy from multiple sources and mix
    system_entropy = collect_system_entropy()
    :crypto.hash(:sha256, system_entropy)
  end

  defp collect_system_entropy do
    # This function gathers entropy for seeding
    time_component = :erlang.system_time(:nanosecond)
    pid_component = :erlang.phash2(self())
    # Use :rand.uniform for additional mixing entropy
    rand_component = :rand.uniform(0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF)
    <<time_component::64, pid_component::32, rand_component::64>>
  end

  defp generate_node_id do
    :crypto.strong_rand_bytes(8)
  end
end

defmodule PdfGen.DocumentController do
  @moduledoc """
  Handles PDF generation requests behind nginx reverse proxy.
  The proxy sets X-Request-ID and X-Forwarded-For headers.
  """

  use Plug.Router

  plug :match
  plug :dispatch

  post "/api/pdf/generate" do
    conn = Plug.Conn.fetch_query_params(conn)
    request_id = get_req_header(conn, "x-request-id") |> List.first()

    case PdfGen.TokenService.generate_download_token() do
      {:ok, token} ->
        download_url = "/api/pdf/download?token=#{token}"
        conn
        |> put_resp_header("x-request-id", request_id || "")
        |> put_resp_header("content-type", "application/json")
        |> send_resp(200, Jason.encode!(%{download_url: download_url, expires_in: 300}))

      {:error, reason} ->
        conn
        |> put_resp_header("x-request-id", request_id || "")
        |> send_resp(500, Jason.encode!(%{error: inspect(reason)}))
    end
  end

  get "/api/pdf/download" do
    conn = Plug.Conn.fetch_query_params(conn)
    token = conn.params["token"]

    case PdfGen.TokenService.validate_download_token(token) do
      :ok ->
        pdf_binary = generate_pdf_content(conn.params)
        conn
        |> put_resp_header("content-type", "application/pdf")
        |> put_resp_header("content-disposition", "attachment; filename=\"document.pdf\"")
        |> send_resp(200, pdf_binary)

      {:error, :expired} ->
        send_resp(conn, 410, "Token expired")

      {:error, :invalid} ->
        send_resp(conn, 403, "Invalid token")
    end
  end

  defp generate_pdf_content(_params) do
    # Simplified PDF generation
    "%PDF-1.4 minimal document content"
  end

  defp get_req_header(conn, header) do
    Plug.Conn.get_req_header(conn, header)
  end
end
